style.backgroundSystem: a #A9846A wood-grille slat wall with visible slat rhythm standing behind a coarse-spun linen plane in #F3EFE6, shallow depth of field, no distant clutter and no duplicated texture
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons in #7FA8B4, uniform 1.5px stroke, each enclosed in a rounded-square frame with a single horizontal bar centered inside
style.lightingSystem: soft 5000K key from the upper left with a wide gentle fill, low contrast, soft-edged contact shadows, no hard specular hotspot, calm mood
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: soft natural baby-care commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of linen off-white #F3EFE6, warm milk-coffee brown #A9846A, deep coffee text #4A4038 and one single celadon-teal accent #7FA8B4; warm temperature; consistent background of a #A9846A wood-grille slat wall behind a coarse-spun linen plane in #F3EFE6; soft 5000K key light from the upper left with wide gentle fill, low contrast and soft-edged contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif at light weight, never mixing serif or handwritten faces; thin-line icons in #7FA8B4, uniform 1.5px stroke, each inside a rounded-square frame with one horizontal bar; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with a credible contact shadow and no floating; no palette change, no mixed fonts, no background swap, no lighting change, no mismatched icon style, no material substitution of the spunlace nonwoven into tissue paper or terry toweling.
noDrift: no palette change, restrict to #F3EFE6, #A9846A, #4A4038 and #7FA8B4
no mixed fonts, no serif, no handwritten, no cartoon lettering
no background swap, no marble, no seamless gradient, no pure #FFFFFF void
no lighting change, key stays upper-left at 5000K and low contrast
no mismatched icon style, every icon is a thin #7FA8B4 line in a rounded-square frame with one horizontal bar
no material substitution, the fiber is spunlace nonwoven and never tissue paper and never terry toweling

no sterilization-rate number, no pathogen name, no ingredient percentage, no sheet count, no dimension number, no age-range label, no registration or certification number, no brand, no QR code, no membership badge
no wound, no broken skin, no open flame, no unsupervised child, no visible child face
no exaggerated water splash, no invented embossed pattern, no floating product
style.presentationRules: stable centered product scale, product always resting on a surface with a credible contact shadow and its bottom edge fully inside frame, vertical lines kept truly vertical, one real scale-reference object in every scene, full-view shots never exceed one third of the set
style.surfaceSystem: coarse-spun linen weave in #F3EFE6 with visible thread texture, accent props limited to matte glazed ceramic and unbleached cotton
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif at a light weight with generous letter spacing, a small tracked English label line set above a short Chinese headline, no serif and no handwritten face
